exposure: neuraxial anesthesia (spinal anesthesia) following thrombocyte transfusion
cohort: Five parturients with severe thrombocytopenia (less than 50 * 10^3/µL) who required cesarean delivery and received thrombocyte transfusion for surgical hemostasis.
finding: No anesthesia-related complications were recorded in cases where spinal anesthesia was performed immediately following thrombocyte transfusion for severe thrombocytopenia prior to cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Spinal anesthesia may be considered for cesarean delivery in parturients with severe thrombocytopenia who were transfused with thrombocytes for surgical hemostasis.
